title: Rakesh Kaushik v. State of U.P. & Another
disposition: Notice issued; interim protection from coercive action granted pending disposal
headnote: Not a Supply Code case — a Section 482 Cr.P.C. application seeking quashing of a charge-sheet under s.434 IPC (mischief by injury to a public road/bridge, in the nature of dishonest damage), arising from a dispute over demolition of the applicant's house pursuant to encroachment-removal proceedings, with allegations of extortion, loot, and criminal intimidation against a local official. No electricity-related content appears anywhere in the order.

holding_units.topic: s.482 Cr.P.C. application to quash a charge-sheet under s.434 IPC arising from an encroachment-demolition/extortion dispute — no Supply Code nexus
holding_units.holding: Notice issued to respondents with time for counter/rejoinder affidavits; interim protection granted restraining coercive action in the pending criminal case, without affecting separate encroachment-removal proceedings or permitting reconstruction of the demolished portion.
